name: X11 window integration (xwlbridge)
description: Lets the xwlbridge X11 bridge keep the X windows it shows on the desktop (-showwindows) in step with GNOME: an X window that moves or resizes itself moves on the desktop too, X windows open where the app asks, and desktop moves, maximising, stacking and focus reach the X app. A process reaches only the Wayland windows it created and tagged (xwlbridge:...), and cannot take the keyboard from another app. No other window can be read or changed through it.
